push.title: W 3-0 vs Liquid Cf | You: 8.4
push.body:
An 8.4, buddskees. That's a B-plus kind of day, and I happen to love B-plus days.

THE GOOD
+ 2 key passes (up from your usual 0). That's what I call neighborly football.
+ A goal against Liquid Cf, your first since Oct 14. That's the sound of the scoreboard saying thank you.
+ Man of the Match, your 6th for us. MOTM. Put it on the fridge and the resume.
+ BellyTb1 scored and you were the reason. Take a bow.
+ Top-rated Grizzly in the match. Little things like that are big things in disguise.

THE BAD
- Only 1 tackle attempted (down from your usual 2). Tiny tweak: As a CDM/CM, screen the back line: stay between the ball and our goal and pick off passes. Rome, day by day.
- Lowest assists on the team: 0 (best was BellyTb1's 1). That's the one I'd circle in red.
- Lowest shots on the team: 2 (best was PhogsToffees's 6). We don't hide from that one; we fix it.
- Lowest on-ball actions on the team: 24 (best was PhogsToffees's 26). Let's call that a lesson and not a trend.

Skill builder: Know your runner before the cross comes in. A quick look over the shoulder saves a goal.

Between you and me, buddskees: Believe it, then go do it.

We'll fix it together. - Coach Lasso

Look at you, BellyTb1. An 8.3 against Liquid Cf. That's the good stuff.

+ 0.7 better than your norm. I'm writing that down in pen.

BellyTb1, from me to you: You miss every pass you don't make, and some you do. Make 'em anyway.

That's a keeper of a performance. - Coach Lasso

push.title: W 3-0 vs Liquid Cf | You: 7.6
push.body:
PhogsToffees, a 7.6 for a forward. Better than most. Not your ceiling, though, not by a long shot.

THE GOOD
+ 6 shots at Liquid Cf's goal. The keeper's arms are probably still sore.
+ 1 key pass. Assists don't make headlines, but they make teams.
+ buddskees scored, but that goal had your name in the credits.
+ Misplaced passes 4, down from your usual 7. That's growth you can count.
+ Missed tackles 2, down from your usual 5. That's what showing up looks like.

THE BAD
- 1 goal from 4 on target. Here's the trick: Side-foot for accuracy inside the box; power is for outside it. Patience, partner.
- Passes attempted 18, down from your usual 33. I'm not mad, I'm just writing it down.
- Tackles attempted 2, down from your usual 6. Think about this: Defend the space, not just the player. Stand in the lane they want to pass into.
- Key passes 1, down from your usual 2. Little homework: Look for the third man: pass to the feet of the player who can find the runner.
- Lowest match rating on the team: 7.6 (best was buddskees's 8.4). That has to tighten up.

Five-minute drill: We're hitting the target, so now aim for the corners. Keepers love a shot down the middle.

PhogsToffees, you already know this, but I'll say it anyway: Run like the ice cream truck just turned the corner.

Patience with yourself, please. - Coach Lasso
